svg.title: One tree. Two reward paths.
svg.desc: One permanent referral tree is shared across asset lanes. A non-earning protocol root has auctioned depth-zero seats. Eligible holdings allocate each lane’s scheduled credits between a holder and fixed commissions to its earning ancestors. Any parent can share a chosen fraction of its gross referral commissions across all lanes with immediate children, weighted by issued credits in family escrow. Escrow principal remains withdrawable after settlement. Net earnings are collected once. Family sharing redistributes the same allocated budget.

g.text: Holdings allocate credits. Families can share referral commissions.
One shared tree across AVA lanes.
Both come from the same source attribution.
Parent chooses a share of commissions
Unshared commissions stay with the parent.
Own rewards + retained commissions + incoming family allocations
Earlier earnings settle before balances or sharing terms change.
The tree divides scheduled credits. Family sharing redistributes that same allocation.
Intended design · Relationships shown are illustrative · Program rules govern committed principal
